page.notes: The woodcut initial "E" is decorative and was transcribed as the letter E. The title line "SPECTATAE TVM" is set in italic capitals with the Æ ligature as printed. Possible misprint: "impegerunt" and "excciderint" transcribed as printed. The first word of the title is partly ornamented; reading of "SPECTATAE" is secure.
